findings: No TypeScript error verification — Acceptance criterion 10 requires confirming no TS errors in TrafficScreen.tsx, but there's no build log or compiler check recorded. Run `tsc --noEmit` or provide the build output.

Segment encoding mismatch — predictor.py uses `hash(segment_id) % 1000` while trainer.py uses LabelEncoder. Predictions won't correspond to trained segments. Align both to the same encoding (hash-based is simpler for stateless prediction).

No retry on predict failure — When `/tracking/traffic/predict` fails, the screen shows cached data but doesn't retry. A user changing departure offset after the API recovers will see stale predictions until they manually refresh. Add a retry timer or re-fetch on the next segment poll.
